description: Parking Transactions is a dataset listed in City of Austin open data portal (datahub.austintexas.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Austin. Note: Due to an integration issue with a vendor, no parking app (ParkATX) transactions have been added to this dataset since October 2025. Physical kiosk transactions are still being added daily. Parking transactions for street parking and city operated lots. This includes data from physical parking kiosks and app payments through ParkATX. Coverage: Austin. The portal files it under the category Transportation and Mobility. Its tags are tpw, transaction, transportation, transportation and public works, finance. The table has 12 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Austin, Texas - data.austintexas.gov. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datahub-austintexas-gov-portal.
